Maneklal Nanavati Law College vs Sir L.A. Shah Law College is a same-city comparison of two Ahmedabad law colleges. The recorded 2023 averages match at ₹4 lakh. One fee figure in our records is not usable.

sections.heading: Maneklal Nanavati Law College vs Sir L.A. Shah Law College for LLB: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: On recorded 2023 placements the two sides are close. Nanavati has an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh. Sir L.A. Shah has an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹6 lakh.

On fees, only Nanavati has a usable recorded year-wise total on this page, at ₹86,000. Sir L.A. Shah has a recorded total of ₹1,600 a year, which is below our professional fee floor, so we do not treat it as the programme fee.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Maneklal Nanavati Law College has a recorded year-wise total of ₹86,000. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed three-year total, until you check the college's official circular.

Sir L.A. Shah Law College's recorded total of ₹1,600 is below the ₹10,000 professional fee floor. Fees that low in our database are treated as data errors, not as the cheapest official tuition. Get the college's current official notice before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 year, so the figures can be read together more fairly than on many other comparisons.

Nanavati's 2023 figures are an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹8 lakh. Sir L.A. Shah's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹6 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Gujarat LL.B. admissions may follow a state or university process, sometimes including a law entrance test.
Read the current official admissions page of each college, and any Gujarat university or Bar Council notice that applies.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both colleges are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different campuses.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, visit both and confirm official fees, because one recorded fee on this page is not usable.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On recorded 2023 averages the two sides are level at ₹4 lakh. Nanavati has the higher recorded highest package and the only usable year fee on this page.
Sir L.A. Shah may still suit you after you have its official fee circular. Do not treat ₹1,600 as the college fee.
Neither college has an NIRF Law rank on this page. Use official notices before you decide.
